notes: Clean on all six. TWO THINGS A RE-READER SHOULD KNOW. (1) The Bancroft finding aid is WRONG on the grantee's forename and the register is right: digicoll's description says 'Granted (1) by Alvarado Mar. 10, 1841, 1 league, by name, to Jose Molina', and its authority heading reads 'Molina, Jose de los Santos, approximately 1805-1837, Grantee' (a death date that cannot be squared with a grant of 1841 anyway); but the concession in the file says 'el Ciudadano Jesus Molina' (stamped p18) and the Board's opinion says 'Jesus Molina' (stamped p75). Hoffman 1862 also has 'Jesus Molina'. Register 'Jesus Molina' stands. (2) The row compresses TWO grants: Alvarado to Jesus Molina, 1 league, 10 March 1841, and Alvarado to Petronilo Rios, 2 leagues, 8 January 1842 per the Board's opinion (the catalogue dates the second grant 6 April 1842). The register's single year 1841 is the date of the first grant only; the second grantee it names was granted in 1842. Graded OK because 1841 is verbatim correct for the foundational concession and the register handles multi-grant ranchos this way elsewhere (cf. rancho-san-antonio-1), but a reader should not infer 1841 for the Rios moiety. Register spells 'Petronillo'; the file spells 'Petronilo'. The Bancroft catalogue's GLO 303 for THIS rancho is confirmed by its own description ('No. 303 General Land Office map'), which is what makes the identical 303 on rancho-san-benito suspect -- see that record's note. District Court proceedings (catalogue: appeal dismissed 8 June 1857) were not reached.
